scientific_integrity: The unrestricted proof is elementary and explicit; a finite trial-division checker corroborates stated small values but does not certify an infinite statement.
scientific_limitations: Only stated exponent classes are resolved. No global sign density, general composite-index classification, or Mersenne-prime infinitude is asserted. Unindexed earlier elementary observations remain a literature risk.
title: Unconditional sign oscillation of the totient–divisor-sum commutator on powers of two
